meta.name: pptx-generator
meta.description: Use when creating, editing, reading, or extracting PowerPoint presentations, including PptxGenJS deck generation, structured PPTX XML edits, or slide-content analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成或编辑 PowerPoint 演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁制作或修改 PPT 文件
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit PowerPoint presentations quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make or modify PPT files

howto.what: 当用户请求创建、编辑或分析PowerPoint演示文稿时，Claude会使用PptxGenJS库生成幻灯片文件，并按照指定流程处理，包括设计模板、分页布局及导出PPTX文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建、编辑或读取PowerPoint文件时触发，例如提出“制作一份PPT”或“分析这份演示文稿”。

say.text: 请帮我生成一份关于新产品的10页演示文稿。
say.note: Claude会按照设计系统生成PPT文件。

say.text: 分析一下这个PPTX文件的内容结构。
修改第五页，把标题改成‘财务预测’。
say.note: Claude会调用编辑流程进行修改。

howto.what_en: When the user requests to create, edit, or analyze a PowerPoint presentation, Claude uses the PptxGenJS library to generate slide files, following a workflow that includes design templates, slide layouts, and PPTX export.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create, edit, or read a PowerPoint file, e.g., 'make a PPT' or 'analyze this presentation'.

say_en.text: Create a 10-slide presentation about the new product.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the PPTX following design rules.

say_en.text: Analyze the content structure of this PPTX file.
say_en.note: Claude uses markitdown to extract text.

say_en.text: Modify slide 5 and change the title to 'Financial Forecast'.
